verifications.claim: The federal tax filing deadline for individuals to submit 2025 tax returns is April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'April 15, 2026, is Tax Day, which signifies the deadline for filing a 2025 federal income tax return.'; R6: 'The tax deadline for 2025 tax returns is April 15, 2026.'; R1: 'Tax returns are due by Wednesday April 15, this year.' (2026 article); R4: 'Taxes must be filed by Wednesday, April 15'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the deadline for 2025 returns as April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers can request an automatic 6-month extension by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'request a six-month extension' by April 15; R3: 'file a tax extension... by the original due date'; R4: 'file for an extension by April 15'; R2/R5: 'request an extension by the April 15 tax filing due date'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm requesting extension by April 15 grants automatic 6-month extension to October.

verifications.claim: An automatic 6-month extension moves the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'six-month extension... until Thursday, Oct. 15'; R3: 'extension deadline... October 15, 2026'; R4: 'moves the filing deadline to October 15'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states 6-month extension to Oct 15, 2026 in 2026-context sources.

verifications.claim: An extension only grants more time to file, not more time to pay taxes owed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'An extension doesn't buy you more time to pay your taxes.'; R2/R5: 'an extension gives extra time to file; it does not give taxpayers extra time to pay'; R3: 'Even if you file an extension, generally at least 90% of the taxes you owe... must be paid by the original due date'; R4: 'You still must pay any taxes owed by April 15'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state extension applies only to filing, not payment.

verifications.claim: Tax Day is April 15, 2026, for filing returns and paying any owed taxes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R4: 'Tax Day 2026 is this month... April 15'; R3: 'April 15, 2026, is Tax Day'; R6: 'April 15, 2026'; combined with payment due April 15 in multiple sources
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Tax Day April 15, 2026 for both filing and payment obligations.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'until Thursday, Oct. 15'; R3: 'October 15, 2026'; R4: 'until Oct. 15'
verifications.reasoning: Directly specifies extension filing deadline as Oct 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: First Quarter 2026 Estimated Tax Payment is due April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The quarterly payments for 2026... First payment: April 15'
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states first quarterly estimated payment for 2026 due April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: Taxpayers stationed outside the U.S. and Puerto Rico on April 15 receive an automatic extension to June 16, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2/R5: 'Members of the military on duty outside the United States and Puerto Rico receive an automatic two-month extension... This year they have until June 16'; 'U.S. citizens and resident aliens who live and work outside... until June 16'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm automatic 2-month extension to June 16 for those outside US/PR; year aligns with standard rule for 2026 context.

verifications.claim: Failing to file on time can lead to a penalty of 5% of the tax due per month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'standard penalty is 5% of any tax due for every month the return is late'; R4: 'penalty of 5% of the tax due for each month the return is late'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes match the penalty description exactly.

verifications.claim: Electronic returns with refunds are typically processed within 21 days.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Most taxpayers who file electronically receive their refunds within 21 days'; R3: 'about 90% of refunds are issued within 21 days of when the return was received'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state 21-day processing for electronic refunds.
